studio.name: Quiet Arcade
studio.tagline: Calm, clever games that respect your time.
principles: Original work only — no borrowed names, art, audio, or content.
Kid-safe & privacy-respecting — no analytics, no tracking, local-first progress.
Deterministic core — game rules live in a single tested module, never duplicated.
Fail-closed ops — hard spend caps, allowlisted inputs, secrets stay out of repos.
